{"metadata":{"description":"运行在 DeepSeek Harness 中的开源办公协作与团队管理插件，让目标、会议、Agent 执行、进度和资料在同一套办公逻辑中持续流动。","id":"gh:1336899053","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"Flowboard","slug":"juntaoding/Flowboard","topics":["ai-assistants","dsh-plugin","knowledge-management","meeting-assistant","project-management","project-management-system","task-management","team-collaboration"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"运行在 DeepSeek Harness 中的开源办公协作与团队管理插件，让目标、会议、Agent 执行、进度和资料在同一套办公逻辑中持续流动。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Flowboard"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Let work happen naturally in the Harness while keeping the team aligned without extra management o"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" happen naturally in the Harness while keeping the team aligned without extra management overhead.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Flowboard is an open-source office collaboration and team management plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DS"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"H). It brings goals, meetings, people, agent execution, progress, and documents into one coherent wo"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"rkflow, so work can move continuously from discussion to execution and shared knowledge. Tasks are n"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ot the boundary of the product; they are the backbone that supports this way of working."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> **Alpha:** `0.1.2-alpha.5` is still at an early validation stage. APIs, data structures, and insta"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"llation procedures may change incompatibly. It is intended for local evaluation and small-team trial"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"s, not stable production deployments."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Management Without the Busywork"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Traditional task management makes employees do the same work twice: first they meet, communicate, an"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"d execute, then they open another system to create tasks, assign owners, update progress, and organi"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ze documents. The management system records a manually maintained copy of the work rather than the w"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ork itself. As soon as people stop updating it, the board becomes inaccurate."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"AI-assisted work makes this problem even more visible. People already use agents in the Harness to r"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"esearch, write, analyze, plan, and execute. If those results remain in individual sessions, the team"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" still cannot see who is doing what, how work is progressing, or what has been produced. Someone eve"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ntually has to copy the information and report it manually."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Flowboard changes how task information is created:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- When work begins, goals and meeting action items become tasks, owners, and plans.
- While work is "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"in progress, members and agents execute and update progress in the same task context.
- When work is"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" completed, documents, decisions, and supporting material return to the original task and project.
-"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" When the team collaborates, every member and agent reads the same authoritative state and continues"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"am collaborates, every member and agent reads the same authoritative state and continues from there."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"People still complete tasks, but no longer have to manage a separate copy of them. **Management happ"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ens as the work happens.**"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## One Operating Model Across the Harness"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The Harness is where people and agents work. Flowboard provides its collaboration and organizational"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" memory layer. Goals set direction, meetings create alignment, people and agents execute together, p"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"rogress stays current, and documents preserve the outcome. Tasks connect these stages instead of bec"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"oming a form that employees must maintain outside their conversations."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## What You Get"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Capability | What it changes |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| AI-native office collaboration | Agents can read team context and connect goals, meetings, tasks, "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"and documents without employees transcribing everything into another system. |
| Jira-style project "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"boards | Manage tasks with workflows such as To Do, In Progress, and Done, including drag and drop, "},{"id":"p19s4","text":"assignees, priority, progress, and due dates. |
| Multidimensional task tables | View and edit tasks"},{"id":"p19s5","text":" in a dense table with custom text, number, date, single-select, multi-select, and people fields. |
"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"| AI meeting secretary | Browser VAD, local Whisper, live transcription, intent revision, persisted "},{"id":"p19s7","text":"action items, and post-meeting summaries form a complete workflow. |
| Documents and organizational "},{"id":"p19s8","text":"memory | Markdown documents can be linked to projects, meetings, and tasks, allowing agents to follo"},{"id":"p19s9","text":"w the history and rationale behind the work. |
| Personal and team perspectives | My Tasks, personal"},{"id":"p19s10","text":" boards, personal calendars, and project workspaces share the same business facts instead of duplica"},{"id":"p19s11","text":"ting data. |
| Authorization and auditability | Writes from both the UI and agents pass through auth"},{"id":"p19s12","text":"orization, runtime validation, idempotency, optimistic locking, transactions, versioning, and audit "},{"id":"p19s13","text":"on, runtime validation, idempotency, optimistic locking, transactions, versioning, and audit logs. |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Requirements"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- Linux x64. The bundled native Whisper runtime is currently available only for this platform.
- Nod"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"e.js `22.19+` or `24+`.
- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6`, with the `dsh` command available.
- About 5"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"00 MB of free disk space. The plugin includes the complete `ggml-small` model."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Data and Security Boundaries"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- DSH is the only host and startup entry point. The Flowboard API, SQLite database, and Worker start"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" and stop with the plugin lifecycle.
- The browser calls the Host only through DSH Typert Remote and"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" never reads or stores an upstream API token.
- Embedded mode generates a random 32-byte access toke"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"n on every startup and uses it only inside the Host.
- The Whisper CLI, shared libraries, and `ggml-"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"small` model are bundled with the plugin. Default transcription does not depend on a system installa"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"tion of Whisper or ffmpeg.
- Audio is processed by the local Flowboard runtime. The Worker removes c"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"ompleted or failed temporary segments.
- Every write goes through the same server-side authorization"},{"id":"p23s8","text":", validation, idempotency, optimistic locking, transaction, and audit pipeline."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"For implementation details, see DSH Native Plugin Architecture and Release Specification and System "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"Architecture Overview. These design documents are currently maintained in Chinese."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Alpha Limitations"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- The default setup currently uses one local Owner. Full account sign-in, invitations, and token man"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"agement are not yet integrated.
- Persistence currently uses SQLite. There is no PostgreSQL adapter "},{"id":"p26s3","text":"or distributed deployment option.
- The bundled Whisper runtime supports Linux x64 only. Other platf"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"orms require additional validated vendor variants.
- The database schema is evolving rapidly and the"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"re is no production migration chain yet.
- Agents can read the workspace, create and update projects"},{"id":"p26s6","text":", tasks, and documents, and process meeting intents. However, not every DSH session is automatically"},{"id":"p26s7","text":" bound to a task; richer execution tracking across sessions remains a product direction."}],"truncated":true}
